name: Mortise
description: A mortise cut square through each block, standing upright in one column and lying flat in the next.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 34%; top: 18%; width: 32%; height: 64%; background: var(--color0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x % 2 == 1) { :after { left: 18%; top: 34%; width: 64%; height: 32%; } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
